XPomeloUsageWarning.description:
Present with the value `near_hard_cap` once the workspace has used 80 %
of its monthly API hard cap. Plan for the ceiling before requests are
refused with `HARD_CAP_REACHED`. Never sent to a token restricted to
tenants.

XRateLimitLimit.description: Maximum requests allowed during current short window.

XRateLimitRemaining.description: Remaining requests in current short window.

XRateLimitReset.description: Unix timestamp when short window resets.

AcquisitionGoalId.description:
Acquisition `include=details` only. Selects one configured goal belonging
to the requested site for conversion impact. Omission uses the union
of all configured goals. An unknown goal or another report variant
returns `INVALID_PARAMS` without charging usage.
AcquisitionGoalId.name: goal_id

ActionFamily.description: Filter action reports by normalized action family.
ActionFamily.name: action_family

ActionKey.description: Filter action reports by normalized action key.

BreakdownDimension.description:
Grouping dimension for breakdown endpoint.
When `dimension=tenant`, rows are grouped by stable `tenant_id`. The
statistics of a tenant are those of the page's tracked space. The
response also includes `tenant_slug` and `tenant_name` as display labels.
BreakdownDimension.name: dimension

BreakdownLimit.description: Number of rows returned by breakdown endpoint.
BreakdownLimit.name: limit

BreakdownListParam.description:
Reads the breakdown as the paginated list of its dimension (`device`:
`devices`, `referrer`: `referrers`, `page`: `pages`, `browser`:
`browsers`, `os`: `systems`, `country`: `countries`). Whole site, no
`filters` and no `tenant_id`. `rows[].value` is the main measure of the
list (pageviews for `pages`, visits for the others); a `metric` other
than `pageviews` for `pages` or `sessions` for the others is refused and `page` carries `next_offset`, `total_rows`, `totals` and
`other`.
BreakdownListParam.name: list

CompareParam.description: Compare current range against the previous equivalent period.
CompareParam.name: compare

ContentInclude.description:
Content response depth. `summary` returns totals and one global
pageview point per day of the site's time zone; `limit` has no effect. `full` returns the
detailed Content report.
When omitted, ranges up to 90 days use `full`; ranges from 91 through
365 days use `summary`.
ContentInclude.name: include

Filters.description:
JSON object serialized as string, example:
`{"device":"mobile","referrer":"google.com"}`.
Filters.name: filters

FromDate.description: Inclusive start date (YYYY-MM-DD), a day of the site's time zone (a UTC date for usage history). Pass explicit from and to dates to bound the requested period.
FromDate.name: from

Interval.description: Granularity (`day` or `hour`, on every plan with API access).
Interval.name: interval

ListOffset.description: Rank of the first row of the page of `list`.
ListOffset.name: offset

ListOrder.description: Order of `sort` (`desc` for a measure, `asc` for `value`).
ListOrder.name: order

ListPageSize.description:
Page size of `list`, when it is not `limit`. Without it `limit` is the
page size (25 when `limit` is absent too); `offset + page size` is at
most 10 000.
ListPageSize.name: list_limit

ListParam.description:
A list of the report read page by page (see Pagination). Content serves
`pages`, `entry_pages` and `exit_pages`; Acquisition serves
`landing_pages`, `referrers` and the Campagnes lists. The page is
returned in `current.lists.<list>` next to the report, which keeps its
own arrays. Needs `include=full` (the default when `list` is given);
not served with a client space (`tenant_id`).
ListParam.name: list

ListSearch.description:
Rows of `list` whose value (path, domain, name) or title contains the
text, case-insensitive, accents significant. A value under ten visits
that the list hides is never found. `other` is null with a search.
ListSearch.name: search

ListSort.description:
Sort of `list`: one of its measures or `value` (alphabetical). The
default is its main measure, descending, ties broken by the value.
ListSort.name: sort

Metric.description:
Metric to aggregate (default `pageviews`). `sessions` uses the same
visit model as the dashboard: a `visit_id` starts from the
privacy-preserving daily visitor key and is split after 30 minutes of
inactivity.
Metric.name: metric

ReportInclude.description: Report depth for Acquisition and Actions. When report include selection is enabled, omission selects summary; otherwise the handler uses full even when include is supplied. No unconditional default is declared here.
ReportInclude.name: include

ReportLimit.description: Number of rows returned by top lists for report endpoints.
ReportLimit.name: limit

TenantId.description:
Stable tenant identifier. Use this for tenant-scoped analytics and
tenant-scoped access control. `site_id` identifies the shared product,
`tenant_id` identifies one tenant.
TenantId.name: tenant_id

ToDate.description: Inclusive end date (`YYYY-MM-DD`), a day of the site's time zone (a UTC date for usage history). Defaults to today.
ToDate.name: to

AnalyticsUnavailable.description:
Analytics serving timed out (`ANALYTICS_DB_TIMEOUT`) or is temporarily
unavailable (`ANALYTICS_DB_UNAVAILABLE`).

Forbidden.description: Token scope/site/plan does not allow this request.

HardCapReached.description: Billing hard cap reached for current month.

InvalidParams.description: Request parameters are invalid, or the result is below the minimum reporting cohort (`REPORTING_THRESHOLD`, no `details`).

ReportAvailabilityConflict.description:
The requested period is not covered by collected data
(`REPORT_NOT_AVAILABLE_FOR_REQUESTED_PERIOD`).

AcquisitionCoverage.description:
Visits with and without a referring domain. A direct visit has no
referring domain.

AcquisitionImpact.description:
Goal impact by landing page. The landing page comes from the visit's
canonical first pageview in the requested scope. A converted visit
matches at least one selected goal; repeated matches count once. Rates
divide converted visits by visits in the same landing page, period and
traffic scope. `channels`, `sources`, `mediums` and `campaigns` belong
to the Campagnes option: they are computed on visits whose visitor gave
consent and are empty without the option.

channels.description: Computed on visits with consent (Campagnes option); empty without the option.

sources.description: Computed on visits with consent (Campagnes option); empty without the option.

AcquisitionReferrerSourceItem.description:
A named source of the provenance, all visits. `domains` lists its
domains of ten visits or more; the rest of the source is its other
domains.

AcquisitionReferrerTypeItem.description: Visits by type of referring site, all visits.

AcquisitionReportResponse.description: Source response variants selected by the effective Acquisition include mode. Current and comparison use the same shape; availability and metering remain present in every variant.

actions.description:
Action rows of the active family, or of every family when none is
selected.

action_id.description: Stable element/action identifier when the action row can be narrowed by it.

action_target_host.description: Target host when the action row can be narrowed by outbound or download target.

form_action_path.description: Form action path when the form action row can be narrowed by it.

form_id.description: Form identifier when the form action row can be narrowed by it.

share.description: Derived from the published counts only; it reveals nothing finer than them.

context.description: Pages and segments around the active family or action.

families.description:
Summary of each action family: goals, forms, outbound, downloads,
errors, custom and instrumentation.

rows.description:
Values of ten visits or more, except the whole-site breakdowns
exact from 1. With a filter, a client space or a raw referrer, the
values under ten visits are grouped in one last row,
`key: "(other)"`, summed before the cut to `limit`; its `value` is
exact from 10 and `null` from 1 to 9, and the row is absent when
nothing is grouped. A client that reads the rows as entities must
skip it.

key.description:
Breakdown key. When `dimension=tenant`, this is the stable
`tenant_id`.

tenant_id.description: Stable tenant identifier for tenant breakdown rows.

tenant_name.description: Current display name for tenant breakdown rows.

tenant_slug.description: Current routing slug for tenant breakdown rows.

metric_method.description: The only Web Vitals measurement method served.

share.description: Derived from the published counts only; it reveals nothing finer than them.
Visible page paths only (not `(other)`). Derived from the published counts only; it reveals nothing finer than them.

ContentReportResponse.description:
Discriminated response union selected by `current.include`. Current and
compare always use the same Content mode.

timeseries.description:
Dense, strictly increasing daily series in the site's time zone. It
contains exactly one point per requested day, including zero-valued
empty days. The
exact daily pageviews add up to the exact period total. Without
any filter, each point and `totals.pageviews` are published
exactly from 1. With a filter, a count from 1 to 9 is published
as `null` (« < 10 »; zero stays `0`), so the returned points
cannot be added up; use `totals.pageviews`.

GoalsConversionsCurrent.description:
Goals whose selected population is below the reporting minimum or
whose converted-session cohort is below the per-cell minimum are
omitted. Consumers must not infer zero when a configured goal is absent.

reporting_status.description:
Always `available` for returned goal rows. Suppressed goals
are omitted rather than returned with zero.

by_channel.description:
Visits with consent by channel (Campagnes option); empty
without the option.

top_referrer_sources.description:
Named sources, all visits: the domains of one service under
its name, counted before the ten-visit threshold. Outside the
whole-site view the sources under ten visits are grouped in
one last row, `source: "(other)"` of type `other`, counted as
`audience.countries`.

top_referrers.description:
Raw referring domains of ten visits or more. The domains under
ten visits are grouped in one last row, `domain: "(other)"`;
its `sessions` is exact from 10 and `null` from 1 to 9, and
the row is absent when nothing is grouped.

browsers.description:
Browser families. Outside the whole-site view the families
under ten visits are grouped in one last row,
`browser_family: "(other)"`, counted as `countries`.

cities.description:
Cities of ten visits or more. The cities under ten visits are
grouped in one last row, `city: "(other)"` and
`country: "(other)"`; its `sessions` is exact from 10 and
`null` from 1 to 9, and the row is absent when nothing is
grouped. The city is read alone: the list is empty with a
hostname, client space, filter or segment.

countries.description:
Countries of ten visits or more (exact from 1 on the whole
site with no filter). Elsewhere the countries under ten visits
are grouped in one last row, `country: "(other)"`; its
`sessions` is exact from 10 and `null` from 1 to 9, and the row
is absent when nothing is grouped.

devices.description:
Device types. Outside the whole-site view the types under ten
visits are grouped in one last row, `device_type: "(other)"`,
counted as `countries`; its averages are `null`.

os.description:
Operating system families. Outside the whole-site view the
families under ten visits are grouped in one last row,
`os_family: "(other)"`, counted as `countries`.

regions.description:
Regions of ten visits or more (exact from 1 on the whole site
with no filter). Elsewhere the regions under ten visits are
grouped in one last row, `region: "(other)"` and
`country: "(other)"`, counted as `countries`.

timezone.description:
IANA time zone of the site, present when it is not UTC (absent:
UTC). The requested dates, the daily `date` values and the hourly
buckets follow it; `start` and `end` are the matching instants in
UTC.

ReferrerType.description:
Type of referring site, read from the referring domain alone through
a fixed table. It never separates paid from organic.

ReportAvailability.description:
Availability of a report for the requested period and its comparison
period. `sections` lists the parts of the report that belong to the
Campagnes option; each one is reported with the reason
`campaigns_option_required` while the option is off.

ReportAvailabilityReason.description:
- `campaigns_option_required`: the data belongs to the Campagnes
  option, which is not enabled on the site.
- `outside_source_coverage`: the requested period is not covered by
  collected data.

ReportAvailabilityRouteId.description: Opaque identifier for the route associated with this availability result.

ReportAvailabilitySectionId.description: Opaque identifier for a section within an availability result.

ReportListPaging.description:
Paging of a list, present when `list` is given. `totals` is the total
of the whole list. `other` is `totals` minus the rows of ranks 1 to
`offset` + page size; a hidden part of 1 to 9 that would leave it at
zero is published "< 10" (`null`), never a zero; it is `null` with a
`search`. Present with `list` on `GET /v1/metrics/breakdown` as `page`.

next_offset.description: Offset of the next page; null on the last one.

total_rows.description:
Rows after masking and search; null when the head of the ranking
proves the order without counting the rest.

ReportLists.description: The page of the list asked by `list`, keyed by its identifier.

ReportSectionAvailability.description:
Availability of a report section that belongs to the Campagnes option.
The report itself is returned with HTTP `200`; the section is empty
when the site does not have the option.

campaigns_enabled.description: Campagnes option of the site: marketing reports (channels, sources, mediums, campaigns) computed on visits whose visitor gave consent. Off by default; the owner or an admin of the workspace sets it, on every plan.

SmallSiteBasis.description:
Small-site rule. A rate, a mean or a percentile needs ten contributors;
below, it is `null` in `current`. When the requested period has fewer,
these are the same totals over the shortest calendar period (ISO week,
month, quarter, year) that contains it and counts ten contributors.
Complement rule: when a filter sets apart 1 to 9 visits of the site in
the requested period, its rates, means, durations and percentiles are
`null` (rows included, and in `compare`), and these totals come from
the shortest such period where the filter sets apart none or at least
ten visits (`reason: filter_complement`). Counts are unchanged.
Absent or `null` when no such period exists.

SurfaceCompareWindow.description: Compare window metadata for report and metrics surfaces.

SurfaceDataFreshness.description: Freshness metadata for a report or metrics surface.

SurfaceExportCapability.description: Export availability for the returned surface and selected plan.

SurfaceMeta.description: Additive metadata for reports and metrics.

reportingPrecision.description: On the whole site, with no filter and no client space, these counts are exact from 1: the totals and the per-day series (visitors, visits, page views, events, and the `period_total` and points of a `day` series), the breakdowns by country, region, device, system, browser, language and screen size, the pages and entry pages, the named sources and the types of referring site, and the goals with their conversions. The cities (a list of those with at least ten visits), the raw referring domains, the `hour` series, every filtered or crossed report and the Campagnes sections publish counts exact from 10; a count of 1..9 is `null`: render it as less than 10, never as a number. 0 is a measured empty count. A filtered report keeps the complement rule. Totals are computed on exact values, then published by the same rule; never add up displayed values. A share follows its count: it is `null` when the count is. A change (`delta`, `delta_pct`) is published only when both counts are 0 or at least 10, and `delta_pct` is a ratio (0.56 is +56%). Rates are published to the percent; 0.005 and 0.995 represent the open tails below 1% and above 99%. Rates, means, durations and percentiles are null under 10 contributors. Last conversion dates have day precision. Usage metering, billing, limits and diagnostics remain exact. This policy reduces detail; it is not a guarantee of anonymity.

bearerAuth.description:
Bearer token created from Dashboard Settings > API Access.
Scopes:
- `metrics:read` -- access to `/v1/me`, `/v1/sites`, `/v1/tenants`,
  `/v1/metrics/*`, `/v1/reports/*`, `GET /v1/goals`,
  `GET /v1/goals/conversions`, and implicitly grants access to
  `/v1/usage/*`.
- `usage:read` -- access to `/v1/usage/*` only.

info.description:
API-first analytics data plane for customer integrations.
- Organization isolation based on API token
- Self-serve API plan gating (retention, intervals, quotas)
- Metered usage for analytics reads
- Exact CTA and conversion reporting through the `actions` and `goals` domains
Operation extensions describe the existing access and charging policy:
`x-pomelo-scopes-any-of` accepts any one listed scope, not all of them;
`x-pomelo-metered` marks analytics reads that may consume usage units.
The `metrics:read` scope also grants access to usage reads.

get.description:
Provenance of every visit: referring domains, the named sources that
gather them (google.fr and google.com under Google), the types of
referring site (search engine, social network, messaging, AI
assistant, other site) and landing pages. A direct visit has no
referring domain. Sources and types are read through a fixed table;
they never separate paid from organic.

Channels, campaign sources, mediums, campaigns and impact by source
belong to the Campagnes option: `by_channel`, `channels`,
`channel_timeseries`, `top_sources`, `top_mediums`, `top_campaigns`,
`dimensions.sources`, `dimensions.mediums`, `dimensions.campaigns`,
`dimensions.contents`, `dimensions.terms` and `impact` (except
`impact.landing_pages`) are computed on visits whose
visitor gave consent, with the usual reporting precision (exact
counts from 10, `< 10` below, rows under 10 visits grouped, rates and means `null`
under 10 contributors), and are empty when the site does not have the
option. `availability.sections` reports `acquisition_attribution` with
the status of the report when the option is on and with the reason
`campaigns_option_required` when it is off. `avg_pages_per_session`,
`avg_session_eng_time_ms` and `avg_page_eng_time_ms` are `null` when
fewer than ten visits contribute; they are never published as `0` in
that case.
When report include selection is enabled, `include` selects the response
depth and omission selects `summary`. Otherwise, `include` is ignored
and the handler uses `full`.
`include=summary` returns totals, coverage and the sessions timeseries.
`full` returns `current.by_day` and top lists. `details` returns
dimensions, landing pages and optional goal impact; it is a distinct
Acquisition variant, not the Content alias for full.
`goal_id` optionally selects one configured site goal for `details`
impact. Impact reports distinct converted visits and rates by landing
page using first-pageview attribution; omission uses the union of the
site's configured goals.

get.description:
Goals, forms, outbound links, downloads, errors, custom events and
instrumentation, by family.
When report include selection is enabled, `include` selects the response
depth and omission selects `summary`. Otherwise, `include` is ignored
and the handler uses `full`.
`include=summary` keeps aggregate families and timeseries and leaves
action/context detail lists empty. `full` and `details` request those
detail rows using the same Actions response schema.

`summary` supports 1-365 inclusive days of the site's time zone. `full` and its deprecated
`details` alias support 1-90 days. Comparison supports at most 30 days
in either mode. Responses are never truncated: if the serialized proxy
response would exceed 5 MiB, the request returns HTTP 422 with
`REPORT_RESPONSE_TOO_LARGE` and consumes zero metered units. Detailed
exports beyond 90 days are not provided synchronously by this endpoint.

Audience, content and acquisition of the site over the requested
period. `avg_pages_per_session`, `avg_session_eng_time_ms` and
`avg_page_eng_time_ms` are `null` when fewer than ten visits
contribute; they are never published as `0` in that case. Channels belong to the Campagnes
option: `acquisition.by_channel` holds visits with consent and is empty
without the option.

post.description:
Requires the dedicated `tenants:write` scope, distinct from the read
scopes; a token restricted to some tenants cannot hold it.

Additive and idempotent. The listed tenants are created or updated;
tenants that are not listed are never changed. Sending the same body
again changes nothing (`unchanged`). A tenant is deactivated only by
an explicit `status: INACTIVE`. The whole body is validated before
the first write; a batch interrupted by a failure is resumed by
sending it again. At most 100 tenants per request: send larger
registries in several requests. A slug already used by another tenant
of the site is refused with `409 TENANT_SLUG_CONFLICT`. A tenant
changed by another write between the read and the write is refused with
`409 TENANT_CONFLICT`: nothing is overwritten, send the request again.

409.description: `TENANT_SLUG_CONFLICT`: a slug is already used by another tenant of the site. `TENANT_CONFLICT`: a tenant was changed concurrently; send the request again.
